content.title: JinkoSolar (JKS) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: Li Xiande: In the first three quarters of 2025, our global module shipments totaled 61.9 gigawatts, once again ranking number one worldwide.  Driven by our outstanding product performance and a strong presence in high-value overseas markets, gross margin improved sequentially for two consecutive quarters to 2.9% in the second quarter and 7.3% in the third quarter.  In the first three quarters, our cumulative energy storage system (ESS) shipments exceeded 3.3 gigawatt hours, increasing significantly for two consecutive quarters.

content.title: JinkoSolar: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: JIANGXI PROVINCE, China (AP) — JinkoSolar Holding Co. (JKS) on Monday reported a loss of $122.3 million in its second quarter. The Jiangxi Province, China-based company said it had a loss of $2.35 per share. Losses, adjusted for non-recurring costs, were $2.30 per share.
